small_guidance: Enable TF32 in tl.dot (allow_tf32=True) since inputs are fp32 — this can ~2x matmul throughput on Ampere/Ada. Also add larger autotune configs (BLOCK_M=128,BLOCK_N=256,BLOCK_K=64, num_warps=8, num_stages=4) and ensure weight_t is stored once at init (already done) so the inner loop is contiguous on K. Consider fusing GELU/bias-add into the GEMM epilogue for the MLP fc layers to remove a pointwise pass.
large_guidance: Redesign to replace the entire GPT2Block (attention + MLP) with fused Triton kernels rather than per-Linear GEMMs: (1) a fused QKV projection + split, (2) a FlashAttention-style fused softmax(QK^T)V kernel avoiding the [B,H,S,S] materialization, (3) fused MLP with GELU epilogue, and (4) fused LayerNorm. This removes many small-GEMM launches (12 layers × ~6 GEMMs) and the large attention-score tensor, which dominate at S=256,B=32. Also avoid the per-call .cuda() H2D copy by ensuring inputs land on GPU once.
